senses.gloss:
ओमः Ved.
—1 A protector; ओमासश्चर्षणीधृतो Rv. 1. 3. 7.
—2 One who is favourably disposed (towards another)
—3 Any one fit to be protected or favoured.

ओमन्^1 m.
—1 Protection.
—2 Favour, kindness.
—3 A kind person.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170124. note: lost virama.

ओमन् + .{@-ना@} A friend, helper, protector; परि घ्रंसमोमना वां वयो
 गात् Rv. 7. 69. 4.

ओमन्वत् a.
—1 Friendly; helping, useful; ओमन्वन्तं चकथुः सप्तवध्रये Rv. 10. 39. 9.
—2 Favourable, kind.
—3 Satiating, pleasing.

ओमात्रा Protection, kindness, assistance; महीं त ओमात्रां कृष्टयो
 विदुः Rv. 10. 50. 5.
